mutations.name: a rollup citation counts its lane whether or not the total is said
kills: Q-E21: every merged PR is named or counted under its lane fails a lane whose rollup is cited but whose total is neither said nor shown

mutations.name: a rollup cited in any chapter counts its lane
kills: Q-E21: every merged PR is named or counted under its lane does not count a lane whose rollup is cited outside the lanes chapter

mutations.name: a lane left out yields no hint line
kills: the Q-E21 repair hint names the left-out lane's rollup fact and total, and the named PR no beat cites

mutations.name: a reflection beat citing any fact passes Q-E22
kills: Q-E22: each reflection proposal cites the slowdown it answers fails a proposal that cites no slowdown fact, and its hint names the beat and the slowdowns to cite
